title: GET /api/users
subtitle: List all users
preview: Returns paginated list of users. Params: page, limit, sort

title: POST /api/users
subtitle: Create user
preview: Body: { name, email, role }. Returns created user.

title: PUT /api/users/:id
subtitle: Update user
preview: Body: { name?, email?, role? }. Returns updated user.

title: DELETE /api/users/:id
subtitle: Delete user
preview: Soft deletes user. Returns 204 No Content.
